answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the jade check immediately, the wharf audit keeps the resolved set and the orchard replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 110 aliases as a result burns the reading cost 110 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
